generationOwner: Codex image-generation tool; the offline HTML editor does not call a model

styles.name: Mono-color
styles.label: 限色印刷
styles.summary: 中性纸面、最多两种油墨、网点与露纸；以一个明确的视觉主体组织画面。
styles.prompt: Create a text-free print artwork on a flat neutral paper substrate, color {paper}. Subject: {subject}. Use at most two printing inks, {ink} dominant and {accent} as a limited accent; give each ink a clear visual role. Mechanical screening, clipped highlights and exposed paper should describe the subject rather than a digital color wash. Keep one dominant image event and a quieter release zone. Do not add aging unless requested. {geometry} No letters, numbers, headlines, captions, logos, QR codes or watermarks. Typography will be added separately in HTML.
checks: 通过网点与露纸形成印刷感

styles.name: Y2K
styles.label: 撞色剪贴
styles.summary: 真实主体剪贴、粗撞色描边、高饱和背景，以及围绕动作设置的少量星芒。
styles.prompt: Edit the supplied photograph into a text-free Y2K cutout artwork. Preserve the actual subject's identity, number, pose, expression and key structures. Use high-contrast grayscale for the subject unless a recognition color must be kept. Add a continuous hard contrasting outline in {ink}, approximately 2–5% of the subject's short dimension, over saturated {paper}. Use {texture}. Anchor one main starburst to an actual bend or shoulder in the silhouette, partly hidden behind the subject; at most two small supporting bursts. Keep faces and essential edges intact. {geometry} No letters, numbers, title, logo, QR code or watermark. All words will be added separately in HTML.
checks: 主体身份、数量和姿态保持

styles.name: Gathered Scenes
styles.label: 实景纸面拼贴
styles.summary: 保留真实场景，以少量抽象形状延续其结构；纤维撕纸边界与一种新增色彩建立联系。
styles.prompt: Transform the supplied scene photo into a text-free, flat paper collage. Preserve its core subjects, direction, perspective and key spatial relationships. Retain a truthful photographic anchor; continue one or two source-derived contours or rhythms into a larger, sparse abstract illustration field. Merge repeated foliage and micro-detail into a few large quiet forms rather than tracing them. Add exactly one extra print hue, {accent}, as a structural continuation, underprint or counterform connected to the source. Keep a narrow, visibly hand-torn fibrous boundary where the photo meets {paper} paper, without raised corners or heavy shadows. {geometry} Substantial paper stays quiet. Do not generate micro-text, titles, letters, numbers, stamps, logos or watermarks. All wording is reserved for HTML.
checks: 真实场景关系仍可识别
文字区安静且无生成文字
